design_decisions: Row counting is an optional DuckDB adapter capability, not an ExecutionEngine protocol expansion; Spark therefore cannot accidentally advertise it.

The adapter checks captured source snapshots before opening a connection, parses exactly one executable StatementSpan, strips only its final terminator, and uses the captured positional parameters in the outer count wrapper.
RowCountController owns one independent QThread and publishes its cancellation handle before count work begins; MainWindow does not share QueryController state.

Each editor tab holds transient count state. A completion must match both the captured request and the tab's pending count ID before it can replace only total_row_count; current-tab success updates the summary and controls without rendering the grid or recording history.
deferred_and_unverified: Manual desktop interaction and multi-gigabyte performance measurement remain unverified in this headless environment.
Spark counting, network filesystems, pagination coexistence, and automatic or cached counts remain intentionally out of scope.
